title: Sweet Potato Soup
subtitle: Silky blended sweet potato with ginger and coconut
excerpt: Sweet potatoes roasted until caramelised, then blended with ginger, garlic, and vegetable stock. A tin of coconut milk adds richness. Naturally vegan and smooth enough to serve without cream.

recipe.sourceNotes: Sweet potato soup is a widely adapted dish that draws on West African, Caribbean, and Southeast Asian traditions in which sweet potato is cooked with ginger and coconut milk. The UK version of this soup became popular in the 1990s and 2000s as sweet potatoes moved into mainstream supermarkets. Roasting the sweet potato concentrates the natural sugars. A small amount of chilli adds warmth without heat.

content.text: Roasting rather than boiling the sweet potato makes a noticeably better soup: the caramelised edges add sweetness and depth that boiling washes away. The coconut milk goes in after blending so it does not split in the oven.

Heat the oven to 200 C / fan 180 C / gas 6. Toss the sweet potato chunks, onion, garlic, ginger, and chilli with the olive oil and a generous pinch of salt on a large roasting tin. Roast for 30 minutes until soft and slightly caramelised at the edges.
Tip the roasted vegetables into a large saucepan. Pour in the hot stock. Blend until completely smooth with a stick blender.
Pour in the coconut milk. Stir to combine. Reheat gently. Add the lime juice and season with salt to taste.
Ladle into bowls. Scatter with fresh coriander.
